title: Artificial Creation (Defect Glass Power)
description:
Adds Artificial Creation to the Defect's card pool, from the concept by u/Suspicious_Badger_18 on r/slaythespire.

[b]Try it now: seed GLASS276.[/b] Start a single-player Defect run with seed [b]GLASS276[/b] and choose Arcane Scroll, Neow's first option. Its random rare card is Artificial Creation.

[b]Artificial Creation[/b] - Rare Power, 3 energy (2 upgraded).
"Whenever you have an empty Orb Slot, Channel 1 Glass."

- Fills empty slots when played, and refills a slot right after an orb is removed or a new slot is gained.
- Channeling into a full queue still evokes the oldest orb, as normal.
- Evokes that don't remove an orb don't create Glass. Shatter doesn't loop.
- Extra copies don't stack: each empty slot gets one Glass.
- Appears in the normal Defect rare pool (rewards and shops). It does not change the starting deck.

Requires BaseLib. Everyone in a multiplayer game needs the mod; live multiplayer hasn't been tested yet.

It also saves local playtest screenshots when Artificial Creation is drawn, played, or offered as a reward. Turn this off with the console command "acrecord off".

Source, screenshots and issue tracker: https://github.com/rrenaud/sts2-artificial-creation
